abstract: Maintains sensitive waterway exclusion mappings and catchments protection audits
system_message:
You are the Environmental impact specialist (ENVS), responsible for maintaining sensitive waterway exclusion mappings and catchments protection audits, as well as conducting catchment water quality sampling.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains sensitive waterway exclusion mappings and catchments protection audits（ECOL）
information_points.content:
ENVS-ECOL-IDF：For the Large airtanker retardant strike package, the riparian buffer exclusion accuracy across mapped permanent streams and wetland boundaries in the drop corridor is 84%, representing the percentage of simulated delivery runs maintaining the mandated 100 m standoff from waterways.
ENVS-ECOL-P49：For the Amphibious water scooper wing, the riparian buffer exclusion accuracy across mapped permanent streams and wetland boundaries in the drop corridor is 99%, representing the percentage of simulated delivery runs maintaining the mandated 100 m standoff from waterways.
ENVS-ECOL-EQ2：For the Heavy twin-rotor bucket package, the riparian buffer exclusion accuracy across mapped permanent streams and wetland boundaries in the drop corridor is 90%, representing the percentage of simulated delivery runs maintaining the mandated 100 m standoff from waterways.

information_points.title: Catchment water quality sampling（WTRQ）
information_points.content:
ENVS-WTRQ-DEQ：For the Large airtanker retardant strike package, the post-incident turbidity baseline recorded at the Grose River downstream tributary monitoring station prior to delivery operations is 15 NTU.
ENVS-WTRQ-C4F：For the Amphibious water scooper wing, the post-incident turbidity baseline recorded at the Grose River downstream tributary monitoring station prior to delivery operations is 5 NTU.
ENVS-WTRQ-G9F：For the Heavy twin-rotor bucket package, the post-incident turbidity baseline recorded at the Grose River downstream tributary monitoring station prior to delivery operations is 10 NTU.
